rows.reason: D2 holds for live assembly but not for the saved-manifest path the same renderer serves. Live: assembleContinuationBrief copies previous.run.endedAt (src/core/agent-runtime/continuation-brief-assembly.ts:915); a requeue needs an ended run with a known outcome (src/core/work-graph/state/task-failure.ts:211; src/core/work-graph/tasks/requeue-service.ts:936-937); every transition to ended writes a string endedAt (src/core/work-graph/state/run-machine.ts:893, :938, :993, with :2498/:2542 keeping a prior non-null value, :1810, :2357). But continuationSuffixOf renders the brief of a stored manifest during fresh admission (src/core/work-graph/tasks/execution-entry-service.ts:973-975, :1058) and continuationBriefVerdict renders it during the Run transition (:1190-1201, :1478), both after readManifestFromEnvelope (:309-349, :480); that reader's codec continuationBriefShapeProblem accepts a null previous.endedAt through previousProblem (src/contracts/continuation-brief.ts:1160-1180). So an old-format or hand-edited stored manifest whose previous.endedAt is null still reaches :604 (the deleted IT04 body, ./.dsh-ref/before/tests/runtime/S1-archive-files-brief.test.ts:253, has exactly that shape). The arm is reached only by reading such a stored record, so U, not D2. T's TP-116 removed an old-format-bytes test for the 79-1 reason, so t_reason_wrong is false.
rows.proposal: Keep the null-endedAt arm untested (AGENTS rule 4 / 79-4: no new tamper test). If deleting it per 79, also narrow ContinuationBriefV1.previous.endedAt to string (src/contracts/continuation-brief.ts:202) and reject null in the shared validator previousProblem (:1180), so readManifestFromEnvelope refuses the stored body at src/core/work-graph/tasks/execution-entry-service.ts:480; dropping only the render guard would print 'null' for an old body. No new test.

rows.reason: The only live producer of workspace.uncommitted, briefWorkspaceFactsFor, gives every status 'unavailable' fact a string reason (src/core/agent-runtime/context-assembler.ts:975-983, :1010-1014) and writes reason null only for git/not_git (:1019-1023), so live assembly is D2. But :687 is a cond-expr in briefBodyZh, and briefBodyZh is also run on a brief loaded from a stored manifest: continuationSuffixOf renders it at src/core/work-graph/tasks/execution-entry-service.ts:975 (called at :1058) and continuationBriefVerdict at :1201 (called at :1478), after readManifestFromEnvelope (:309-349, :480). The shape check accepts unavailable+reason null through uncommittedProblem (src/contracts/continuation-brief.ts:1382-1389). The deleted IT04 body has exactly status 'unavailable' with reason null (./.dsh-ref/before/tests/runtime/S1-archive-files-brief.test.ts:253), so an old-format or hand-edited stored manifest reaches the arm. That is U, not D2; t_reason_wrong is false because TP-116 removed an old-format test for the 79-1 reason.
rows.proposal: Keep the null-reason arm untested (rule 4). If deleting it per 79, make workspace.uncommitted a union where status 'unavailable' implies reason: string (src/contracts/continuation-brief.ts:245) and reject null in uncommittedProblem (:1382-1389), so readManifestFromEnvelope refuses the stored body at src/core/work-graph/tasks/execution-entry-service.ts:480; deleting only :687 would render an empty reason for an old body. No new test.
